meta.name: tax
meta.description: Structures the tax questions a growing business faces — corporate income, sales and use, payroll, nexus, and the obligations created by hiring or selling somewhere new. Use this to work out what a new state or country obligates you to, prepare for a tax filing or audit, understand sales tax on your product, or check what a remote hire or new market triggers.

copy.tagline: 明确企业税务义务，备好报税与审计。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果企业正走向新市场,需要理清税务义务。
copy.tagline_en: Clarify your business tax obligations and prepare for filings and audits.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your growing business needs to understand tax duties in new jurisdictions.

howto.what: 这个技能帮你梳理成长中企业要面对的税务问题:公司所得税、销售税、工资税、nexus(税务关联),以及因为在新地方雇佣或销售而产生的义务。它把问题结构化,告诉你该问什么、该准备什么。
howto.when: 当你想弄清新州或新国家对你有何纳税义务、要准备报税或审计、想了解产品如何缴销售税、或想查看远程雇佣或新市场是否会触发义务时使用。

say.text: 我在新州雇了一个远程员工,要注册哪几种税?
say.note: 技能列出由此产生的登记与申报义务。

say.text: 我的 SaaS 产品在德州要收销售税吗?
say.note: 提示你确认产品分类并留存书面结论。

say.text: 我们跨过了某州的收入门槛,接下来要做什么?
say.note: 触发 nexus 复核和登记时机检查。

howto.what_en: This skill structures the tax questions a growing business faces: corporate income, sales and use, payroll, nexus, and obligations created by hiring or selling somewhere new. It organizes the issues and tells you what to ask for.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need to determine what a new state or country requires of you, prepare for a tax filing or audit, understand sales tax on your product, or check what a remote hire or new market triggers.

say_en.text: I hired a remote employee in a new state. Which taxes do I need to register for?
say_en.note: The skill lists the resulting registrations and filings.

say_en.text: Is my SaaS product subject to sales tax in Texas?
say_en.note: Prompts you to confirm classification and keep it in writing.

say_en.text: We crossed a revenue threshold in a state. What should we do?
say_en.note: Triggers a nexus review and registration timing check.
